description: This file is a PHP source script for a sample client supporting XML-RPC interactions with TestLink's API. It includes external dependencies, sets up some JavaScript for UI interaction, and defines server-side logic to generate an HTML page with embedded scripts and configurations.

classes.name: DetailController
classes.description: JavaScript object managing the toggle of detail display elements on the web page.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Method to show or hide HTML elements based on their ID, simulating an expand/collapse feature.
